title: What is personal profile?
competency: Explain what a personal profile is and why it is prepared.

keywords.def: Detailed information about a specific person: who they are and what they have.
A quality or feature a person has, like being hardworking.

ideas.name: What a personal profile is and why we prepare it

en.text: A personal profile is a short introduction about you: your characteristics, qualities, education and experience. It introduces you to others. It is also needed when applying for a job, because employers want to see if you have the right skills, knowledge and experience.

screens.title: Tell me about yourself
screens.ask: A new teacher asks: "Tell me about yourself." What will you tell her?
opts: My name, age, school, grade and what I am good at
screens.after: Telling who you are and what you can do is giving your personal profile.

screens.title: Brainstorming question
screens.ask: Write three attributes that tell who you are.
screens.answer: Example: "I am hardworking. I am good at drawing. I like helping others."

screens.title: 2.3.1 What is personal profile?
paras: A personal profile is a short introduction about you.
It outlines your characteristics, your attributes and qualities.
It includes your educational level and your experience.
Someone may ask your name, age, school, grade and place of birth.

screens.title: Skills too
paras: Someone may ask about your skills: cooking, translating, singing or writing.
Then they are asking for your personal profile.
It is detail information about who you are and what you have.

screens.title: Why prepare one?
paras: A personal profile introduces you to others.
It is also needed to get a job; it is a requirement when applying.
Employers use it to see if you have the skills, knowledge and experience for the job.
screens.note: You will learn more in Units 7 and 8.

screens.text: Mesfin applies to be a waiter. Which is the MOST useful line in his profile?
opts: "I served customers at my uncle's café for two summers."
screens.ans: "I served customers at my uncle's café for two summers."
screens.why: Employers look for skills and experience related to the job. His café experience fits a waiter job.
screens.clue: Which line helps the employer judge the job skills?
